s.note: his tag-team partner snacking on the street
s.how: Cut 12 corn tortillas into wedges and fry at 180C until crisp, then toss in salt, lime zest and chilli powder. Dice 4 tomatoes and half a white onion and mix with lime juice and salt for a fresh salsa. Serve the chips warm with the salsa.

s.note: the crowd at the lucha libre arena
s.how: Grill 4 corn cobs over high heat until charred all over. Brush with mayonnaise mixed with lime juice. Roll in crumbled feta, then sprinkle with chilli powder and chopped coriander. Serve hot with lime wedges for squeezing over at the table.

m.note: the proper feast he buys with his winnings
m.how: Dice 2 chorizo and 400g potatoes and fry with a sliced white onion and a little chilli until crisp and golden. Quickly pickle more sliced onion in lime juice. Spoon into warm corn tortillas with sliced avocado, pickled onion and coriander.

w.note: the sweet treat for the orphans
w.how: Bring 250ml water and 60g butter to the boil, beat in 150g flour, then beat in 2 eggs. Pipe lengths into 180C oil and fry until golden. Roll in cinnamon sugar. Melt 150g dark chocolate with a splash of hot water for a sauce and serve warm.

d.note: a sweet rice drink for the kids
d.how: Soak 200g long grain rice and 2 cinnamon sticks in 1L water overnight. Blend until smooth, then strain through a fine cloth. Stir in 100g sugar and 250ml milk until dissolved. Chill well and pour over ice with a pinch of cinnamon on top.
